title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-zt3c.13: stale ULA/GUA reference in spec/03-adaptation.md:71 (Rule 1)
description:
Commit e9528d8e5 updated ULA/GUA -> 02xx references across 5 spec files but missed spec/03-adaptation.md:71, which still says:

> Rule 1: Mesh-local IPv6+UDP+CoAP (26B SCHC header, ULA/GUA with /64 prefix MSB match)

This should read: '02xx with /64 prefix MSB match' or 'mesh prefix with /64 MSB match' to be consistent with the rest of the spec (lines 10, 74 in appendix-schc.md now use 02xx; Rule 1 table in draft-lichen-schc-lora-00.md:200 uses mesh_prefix/64).

The commit changed Rule 4 description in this same file (line 74) but overlooked Rule 1 (line 71).
